notes: Summary: Aurum is evaluating a Dedicated + Private deployment for latency-sensitive trading assistants and embeddings-based risk scoring.
Primary asks: 99.95% uptime guarantee for core inference endpoints, P95 latency SLO <= 120ms for short-chat (<=256 tokens), p50 < 30ms for embeddings lookup path.
Throughput expectations: initial reserved pool = 16 A100-equivalent GPUs with predictable sustained throughput of ~40k tokens/sec aggregate; burst to 24 GPUs for market-open spikes.
Latency SLO details: agreement needs explicit measurement windows and sampling methodology (synthetic harness vs traffic mirroring). Customer insists on p95 measured at edge after routing + queuing.

Credit schedule proposed by Redwood (initial): sliding credits starting at 0.5% monthly credit for 99.9-99.95, 1.5% for 99.5-99.9, escalates thereafter. Aurum legal wants higher credits and lower cap on liability.
Maintenance windows: customer requires maintenance window not overlap EU market open (08:00-09:30 CET). wants no forced restarts during trading hours and 30-day advanced notice for major upgrades.
Support SLA: 15-minute P1 response target, 2-hour mitigation SLA, 24/7 phone escalation to named on-call for production incidents. Aurum requests quarterly runbook reviews with CSM + SE.

Capacity planning: need runway for 3x concurrency growth over 12 months; want reserved GPU sizing formula tied to tokens/sec and concurrency targets; ask for monthly usage cadence and autoscale bursting policy documented.

Failover & graceful degradation: must include model-variant fallback (quantized variant) with documented quality delta and automatic routing during capacity shortfall; failback testing required in POC.
Security/compliance: EEA data-residency clause mandatory, KMS integration for keys, detailed audit log retention (1 year) and support for customer-managed key option in private deployment.

POC plan (current): 2-week perf run using production-like traces; evaluate p95 latency under market-open burst profile; SE to provide test harness and pre-provisioned 8-GPU pilot cluster w/ dedicated routing policy.
Quotes from call: 'We cannot accept maintenance during market open windows' — Head of SRE; 'Credit tiers need to be meaningful vs. cost of downtime' — CFO.
Legal redlines outstanding: liability cap, credit calculation window, service credit auto-apply vs. claim-based, indemnity wording, force majeure definition around cloud provider incidents.
Commercial ask: 24-month committed reserved capacity discount with options to step-up at predefined milestones; prefer quarterly review vs. annual to adjust burst sizing.

Recent decision drivers: sensitivity to tail-latency -> will prioritize providers with explicit p95 guarantees and measurable SLIs; strong preference for private VPC deployment due to regulatory audits.
Internal notes: AE -> Maya working pricing; SE Diego to deliver test harness by 2024-12-15; Legal sync planned 2024-12-18; CSM Jordan prepping onboarding checklist if contract executes.
Next demo: schedule live SLA test during simulated market open on 2024-12-20 (SE + on-call + customer SRE).
Risk: if credit schedule negotiation stalls, procurement timeline slips and Aurum may pilot with competitor for immediate needs.
